children: The Oct. 24 festival in Irvine will feature a VIP lounge, returning exhibitors, tastings and live entertainment

magazine, Raising Cane's and OPHORA Water are joining SoCal Cocktail and Spirits Fest as the official media partner, community sponsor and official water sponsor, respectively. The festival returns for its third year Oct. 24 at Gillette House in Irvine.
magazine VIP Lounge. The experience will include a curated caviar offering and unlimited spirits tastings. The magazine will also cover and promote the festival.

Returning partners include La Tequila Club, also known as LATC, and NEAT Glass, each returning for a third consecutive year; Castaway Photobooths, the festival's photo activation partner; and Louie's Liquor, the on-site retail sales partner. Attendees can purchase participating products at the event.

Several brands that were exhibited at the 2025 festival are registered to return in 2026. They include Casa Maestri, represented by Platinum Brands; Cazcanes Tequila; Matiari Tequila, represented by Sans Wine & Spirits; and Hacienda Vieja Tequila, represented by NAFTA Distributors.
"The continued support of our partners and returning exhibitors is a testament to the value and impact of SoCal Cocktail and Spirits Fest," said Paul Hashimi, CEO of the SIP Awards. "From

magazine's VIP Lounge experience and Raising Cane's community involvement to OPHORA Water's support and the commitment of our returning exhibitors, these relationships help create a first-class event that celebrates innovation, craftsmanship and connection across the spirits industry."

The festival will feature unlimited tastings, live music by AURA, a red carpet experience, a 360-degree photo booth, permanent jewelry activations, live pet adoption opportunities and a silent auction benefiting MeoowzResQ. All silent auction proceeds will go to the organization.
For tickets and information, visit sipawards.com/cocktail-spirits-fest.

SoCal Cocktail and Spirits Fest brings together consumers, bartenders, brand founders, distributors, retailers, and hospitality professionals for tastings, educational opportunities, networking, and interactive experiences. The festival celebrates award-winning spirits and connects brands with consumers and industry professionals.
ABOUT FAST MOVING CONSUMER GOODS INC.

Fast Moving Consumer Goods Inc. (FMCG), a sponsor of the 2026 SoCal Cocktail and Spirits Fest, works with founders and businesses developing products in categories including beverages, beauty, nutritional supplements, and spirits. The company supports product development, manufacturing, sales and distribution.

title: Orange Coast Magazine, Raising Cane's and OPHORA Water Join SoCal Cocktail and Spirits Fest as Featured Partners
